ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the geological profile, the rock layer labeled 1 in the central lower part is located below the rock layer labeled 3; on the left side, label 5 appears as an intrusive rock body, cutting through the older rock layers around it, but its top is covered or truncated by the overlying dotted rock layer labeled 2; label 4 is vein-shaped and cuts through label 2 as well as the underlying rock layers. Reasoning: According to the principle that in sedimentary rock layers the lower is older and the upper is newer, 1 is earlier than 3; according to the intrusive relationship, 5 cuts through older rock layers such as 1 and 3, so 5 is later than 1 and 3; but 5 is also covered or truncated by 2, so 5 is earlier than 2; 4 cuts through 2 and the underlying rock layers, indicating that 4 formed latest. Combining the chronological relationships, the rock formation order is 1, 3, 5, 2, 4.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的接触关系：中央下部的1在3之下，故1早于3；左侧5为穿切较老岩层的岩体，但其顶部被上方点状岩层2覆盖或截断，故5晚于1、3而早于2；4呈脉状穿过2及下伏岩层，故4最晚。将这些先后约束合并，得到形成顺序为1、3、5、2、4。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：地质剖面中，中央下部标号1的岩层位于标号3岩层之下；左侧标号5呈侵入岩体状，穿切其周围较老岩层，但其顶部被上方点状的标号2岩层覆盖或截断；标号4呈脉状，穿过标号2以及下伏岩层。推理：根据沉积岩层下老上新的原则，1早于3；根据侵入关系，5穿切1、3等较老岩层，所以5晚于1、3；但5又被2覆盖或截断，所以5早于2；4切穿2和下伏岩层，说明4形成最晚。综合先后关系，岩石形成顺序为1、3、5、2、4。
